viewing_check: Weigh the chip necklace if possible (heavier natural amber is light, about 15 to 30g for this length). Check amber floats in salt water, is warm and light to hold, smells resinous with a hot pin (do not damage), drill holes show no seams or bubbles, chips irregular not moulded. Check silver chain hallmarks (925) and clasps, and the red drop for glass or plastic.
